makaroni4/guitar_bro

Upstream is a Chrome-only Web Audio FFT tuner that holds a live microphone
(jQuery, d3, Google Analytics, Font Awesome, Facebook/Twitter share). GifOS
apps cannot hold a live mic — they get a clip via gifos.recordAudio — and
the runtime inlines <script src> as classic scripts, so those CDNs cannot
ride in.

This directory is the port: the same strings, frequencies, songs, survival
hearts and falling-note scoring, rewritten as classic scripts. Tap a fret
to play; Listen records a short clip on this device and names the note.
A race publishes each person's score on their own row. Nothing is fetched.
